title: Riot Squad Pod Liq Peach Cherry Lemonade 80ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Pod Liq Shortfills are the latest innovation from Riot Squad that let you enjoy the long-lasting value and great flavours of Shortfill E-liquids in a huge variety of vape kits that use higher-resistance coils. Pod Liq’s unique 60%PG/40%VG ratio is tailor-made for MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) vaping with its perfect balance of vapour, flavour and throat hit. Available in 120ml bottles with 80ml of 0mg E-liquid, you have the freedom to tailor your nicotine content with the use of Nicotine Shots . Two x 10ml 18mg 70/30 Nicotine Shots added to an 80ml Shortfill bottle of Riot Squad Pod Liq E-liquid will create approximately 100ml of 3mg 50/50 E-liquid While Four x 10ml 18mg 70/30 Nicotine Shots added to an 80ml Shortfill bottle of Riot Squad Pod Liq E-liquid will create approximately 120ml of 6mg 50/50 E-liquid. Peach Cherry Lemonade from Riot Squad's Pod Liq 60/40 Shortfill collection is your ticket to a sun-drenched oasis of flavour. Picture yourself lounging by the pool on a hot summer day, sipping a fruity beverage—that's exactly the experience this e-liquid aims to recreate, and it does so spectacularly. From the get-go, the smooth and velvety texture of ripe peaches greets your taste buds, instilling a sense of warm, sunny contentment. This is swiftly followed by the succulent burst of cherries, adding a layer of depth and complexity that enriches the initial peachy sweetness. But what truly sets this blend apart is the invigorating splash of lemonade that cascades over these fruity notes, providing a zesty edge that is both refreshing and remarkably authentic. Whether you're at a barbecue, a beach, or simply enjoying a quiet moment, this e-liquid is like a slice of summer you can relish all year round. It encapsulates the essence of what a fruit-infused lemonade should be: refreshing, uplifting, and bursting with character.
